name: rules-rtdb-r11-string-validation
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r11-string-validation" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). every string method the RTDB rules language exposes decides one field of a handle record — length, contains, endsWith, toLowerCase, beginsWith, matches against a regex literal, replace and toUpperCase — so a per-field deny pins each method against production.
